set.known_text: પોતાને ઘણી ખરાબ રીતે ઈજા પહોંચાડી

L01.why: S3: 'quite' is in the seed ('No I think he's hurt himself quite badly') and no LEGO of the seed carries it (L01 is the seed's only LEGO; 'badly' is S0338L01). The only way to carry it without a new LEGO is to grow L01 across 'quite badly' (6 syllables, ungapped, a piece of the seed). Known side is the wording U01/U06 already use (ઘણી ખરાબ રીતે).

B01: પોતાને ઘણી ખરાબ રીતે ઈજા પહોંચાડી

notes: cs #813 re-cut: L01 'hurt himself' grows to 'hurt himself quite badly'. Every row that lacked the whole new LEGO is re-said with it (P17); U01 and U06 already contain it and are untouched. Cost, stated plainly: the basket is now all 'quite badly' sentences, and the plain 'hurt himself' is only a component.
